user.title: Pair with the Home Security engine
user.description: On the engine's setup page, make a pairing code, then enter the engine's address and the code here.

data_description.code: Eight letters and digits, like ABCD-EF23. It works once, for 15 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The engine at {url} no longer accepts this Home Assistant. Make a new pairing code on the engine's setup page and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Change the engine
reconfigure.description: To move to a new engine address, or to pair again on purpose: make a pairing code on the engine's setup page and enter the address and the code here. Alerts keep the same webhook.

data_description.code: Eight letters and digits, like ABCD-EF23. It works once, for 15 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the engine at that address.
error.invalid_code: The engine refused that code: it is wrong, used up or expired. Make a new one.
error.no_internal_url: Set Home Assistant's local network URL first (Settings > System > Network), so the engine can send alerts to it.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong; see the logs.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Security is already set up.

data_description.phones: Phones with the Home Assistant app. None chosen means no phone alerts.
data_description.script: Optional. A script that sends notifications for you (for example a notification hub). The guard's alerts go to it instead of straight to the phones; other alerts still go to the phones. If the script is missing or unavailable, the guard's alerts go to the phones. Taking an earlier alert off the phones (when alerts are turned off, or a story joins another) always goes to the phones chosen above, so pick the phones the script delivers to as well. Leave empty to notify the phones directly.
data_description.script_source: Passed to the script as `source`. Used only when a script is chosen.

mark_fine.name: That's fine
mark_fine.description: Tell the engine a story is fine.

not_loaded.message: Home Security isn't connected to its engine.
